prompt.alinti: AI agents are getting way too much freedom lately. You've probably heard about these digital helpers that can browse the web or run programs for you, but giving them full control over your computer is like handing your house keys to a complete stranger and hoping they don't break anything. That is exactly why this project called OpenShell is blowing up with 10,760 stars right now.

It acts like a strict security guard that sits between your computer and any AI agent you decide to run. Instead of letting an agent poke around your private files or copy your passwords, you set up a clear list of rules that it has to follow.
If the agent tries to peek at a folder you didn't approve or send data to a website you don't trust, OpenShell just stops it in its tracks.
It even checks its own work to make sure your security rules aren't missing any hidden loopholes before they start.
It's basically a locked room for your agents. It uses AI to do its work without being able to reach anything you want kept private.
You can check it out yourself on their GitHub page.
